import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")


def engineer_features(df):
    df = df.copy()

    # Extract character frequencies from f_27
    f_27_chars = df["f_27"].str.split("", expand=True).drop(columns=[0, 10])
    for i in range(1, 10):
        for char in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ":
            col_name = f"f_27_char_{char}_{i}"
            df[col_name] = (f_27_chars[i] == char).astype(int)

    # Character counts
    for char in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ":
        df[f"count_{char}"] = df["f_27"].str.count(char)

    # Statistics for f_27 string
    df["f_27_unique_chars"] = df["f_27"].apply(lambda x: len(set(x)))
    df["f_27_max_repetition"] = df["f_27"].apply(
        lambda x: max([x.count(c) for c in set(x)]) if x else 0
    )

    # Cumulative statistics for character positions (sequential dependencies)
    char_positions = [f"f_27_char_{char}_{i}" for char in "ACGT" for i in range(1, 10)]
    df["cumsum_ACGT_positions"] = df[char_positions].cumsum(axis=1).mean(axis=1)
    df["cummax_ACGT_positions"] = df[char_positions].cummax(axis=1).mean(axis=1)

    # Continuous columns
    continuous_cols = [
        "f_00",
        "f_01",
        "f_02",
        "f_03",
        "f_04",
        "f_05",
        "f_06",
        "f_19",
        "f_20",
        "f_21",
        "f_22",
        "f_23",
        "f_24",
        "f_25",
        "f_26",
    ]

    # Difference features (consecutive time-like columns)
    diff_pairs = [
        ("f_01", "f_00"),
        ("f_03", "f_02"),
        ("f_05", "f_04"),
        ("f_21", "f_20"),
        ("f_23", "f_22"),
        ("f_25", "f_24"),
    ]
    for col1, col2 in diff_pairs:
        df[f"{col1}_minus_{col2}"] = df[col1] - df[col2]
        df[f"abs_{col1}_minus_{col2}"] = np.abs(df[col1] - df[col2])

    # Summary stats
    df["sum_continuous"] = df[continuous_cols].sum(axis=1)
    df["mean_continuous"] = df[continuous_cols].mean(axis=1)
    df["std_continuous"] = df[continuous_cols].std(axis=1)
    df["max_continuous"] = df[continuous_cols].max(axis=1)
    df["min_continuous"] = df[continuous_cols].min(axis=1)

    # Top features for interactions
    top_5 = ["f_02", "f_05", "f_21", "f_22", "f_23"]
    top_3 = ["f_02", "f_05", "f_21"]

    # Pairwise products
    for i in range(len(top_5)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(top_5)):
            df[f"{top_5[i]}_x_{top_5[j]}"] = df[top_5[i]] * df[top_5[j]]

    # Squared terms
    for col in top_5:
        df[f"{col}_squared"] = df[col] ** 2

    # Cubic terms for top 3 features
    for col in top_3:
        df[f"{col}_cubed"] = df[col] ** 3

    # Ratio features
    ratios = [
        ("f_02", "f_03"),
        ("f_21", "f_22"),
        ("f_22", "f_23"),
        ("f_05", "f_00"),
        ("f_21", "f_02"),
        ("f_22", "f_05"),
        ("f_01_minus_f_00", "f_02"),
        ("f_03_minus_f_02", "f_05"),
    ]
    for num, den in ratios:
        col_name = f"{num}_by_{den}"
        df[col_name] = df[num] / (df[den] + 1e-8)

    # Top f_27 count features interacting with difference features
    top_f27_counts = ["count_A", "count_T", "count_G", "count_C"]
    diff_features = ["f_01_minus_f_00", "f_03_minus_f_02", "f_05_minus_f_04"]
    for feat in top_f27_counts:
        for diff_feat in diff_features:
            if diff_feat in df.columns:
                df[f"{feat}_x_{diff_feat}"] = df[feat] * df[diff_feat]

    # Integer features as categorical
    int_cols = [
        "f_07",
        "f_08",
        "f_09",
        "f_10",
        "f_11",
        "f_12",
        "f_13",
        "f_14",
        "f_15",
        "f_16",
        "f_17",
        "f_18",
        "f_29",
        "f_30",
    ]
    for col in int_cols:
        df[col] = df[col].astype("category")

    return df


# Apply feature engineering
train_df = engineer_features(train)
test_df = engineer_features(test)

# Define feature columns
exclude_cols = ["id", "target", "f_27"]
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

X = train_df[feature_cols]
y = train_df["target"]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]

# Stratified train-validation split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Create datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC: {auc_score:.6f}")

# Predict test set and submit
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)
submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission["target"] = test_pred
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved!")
